# mxagent

> Control AI agents from an end-to-end encrypted Matrix space. A Node.js daemon logs in as one bot account, gives every agent its own room and accepts messages only from the configured owner's cross-signed sessions. Agents connect over a Unix socket or an encrypted, mutually authenticated WebSocket using a newline-delimited JSON protocol, with SDKs for JavaScript and Python and an MCP adapter.

The daemon runs TypeScript directly on Node.js >= 22.18 (no build step) and works with any Matrix homeserver that supports end-to-end encryption, cross-signing and spaces. `docs/reference/protocol.md` is the authoritative wire contract.

Run from a checkout: daemon `npm start`, admin CLI `node cli/mxagentctl.ts <command>` (or `npm run ctl -- <command>`), MCP adapter `node adapters/mcp/server.mjs --name <agent>`. No binaries are installed. Python package and import name: `mxagent`; JavaScript package: `mxagent` (`clients/js`); the repository root is the private package `mxagent-daemon`.

## Docs

- [Docs index](docs/README.md): which document to read for which goal
- [Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, configure, log in, anchor and verify the bot (cross-sign with the daemon stopped), connect local and remote agents
- [Configuration](docs/guide/configuration.md): config file, all MXA_* settings, agent settings, state directory
- [Commands and rooms](docs/guide/commands.md): control-room commands, reply routing, approvals, delivery reactions, updates, polls
- [Security](docs/guide/security.md): who can see and send what, secrets to protect, threat model, residual risks
- [FAQ](docs/guide/faq.md): homeserver support, design choices, offline agents

## Reference

- [Agent protocol](docs/reference/protocol.md): transports, WebSocket handshake, message types, delivery semantics
- [Protocol test vectors](docs/reference/protocol-test-vectors.md): fixed handshake inputs and outputs for new SDKs
- [Architecture](docs/reference/architecture.md): components and module responsibilities with file paths
- [Daemon internals](docs/reference/internals.md): exported API and behaviour of the modules in src/daemon/
- [Technical changelog](docs/reference/changelog-technical.md): changes marked by protocol and agent impact

## SDKs and adapters

- [JavaScript SDK](clients/js/README.md): zero-dependency client, Node >= 22
- [Python SDK](clients/python/README.md): asyncio client, Python >= 3.10
- [MCP adapter](adapters/mcp/README.md): exposes the protocol as MCP tools plus an inbox
- [Examples](examples/README.md): echo, approval gate, CLI bridge, poll agent
